findings.summary: The 'Promote to build' step — the product's own path to compile the locked brief into builder tasks — failed three consecutive times with a raw '500 Internal Server Error' shown in the confirm dialog, leaving 'Confirm and compile' permanently disabled. The handoff had to be done manually via the New Task dialog instead.

Submitting the discovery questionnaire failed silently (HTTP 409, then two HTTP 400s, visible only in the console) — the page kept saying 'Ready to send.' with no error message, and reloading wiped all selected answers, forcing full re-entry. The same answers were later accepted unchanged, so the rejections were spurious.

In the Create Task dialog, two different projects render identically truncated labels ('I want a REST API that shortens URLs, with rate limiting …') in the Project dropdown, making it impossible to tell which project a task is being attached to without checking afterwards.

Data that was accepted came back byte-for-byte intact across /reload and a fresh new-tab session: the mission ask 'I want a REST API that shortens URLs, with rate limiting per client (returning-user acceptance pass #7).', all 13 discovery answers, the locked-brief state, and the handoff task title 'Build the URL shortener REST API per locked brief (pass #7)' with its full 141-character description assigned to the developer.
